title: Chapter 768
paragraphs: Chapter 768
189. Rolling in Fortunes(2)
Upon Jin’s gesture, the knights who were roughly holding onto the boy let go and backed off.

“Wow! I get to meet Jin in person! Nice to meet you, Jin! My name is Luche Pibrizio! I'm from the southern town of Kol in the Barkl Autonomous District and I'm sixteen years old. And I'm a distinguished member of both the official and unofficial fan clubs of Jin Runecandel…”
Luche paused his introduction, pulling out the official badges of the fan clubs run by Enya and Sandra.
Despite his ragged appearance, the badges were impeccably clean, shining brilliantly.
‘…Enya and Sandra don’t just give those to anyone.’
Luche kept a gleaming smile on his face as he presented his two badges, waiting until Jin nodded in acknowledgement.
At the sight, Telrot rubbed his forehead, as if in discomfort.
He never thought that Luche, who had already given him a hard time, would act so recklessly in front of Jin Runecandel, the chief butler.
"I am known amongst the fan clubs as Luche of Tenacity, a true Jin enthusiast."
“Hmm... Well, let’s start with a handshake then. I appreciate your admiration for me.”
“Wow, such an honor. A handshake with Jin? That's insane. Excuse me, Sir Telrot, could I get a handkerchief?”
“Heh, this situation is laughable. How did this kid lose all his fear?”
As Telrot reluctantly handed over a handkerchief, Luche quickly dirtied it by wiping his hands before shaking hands with Jin.
The act of returning the soiled handkerchief left Telrot flabbergasted once again.
While Luche held onto Jin's hand a bit longer than usual, causing Jin to feel awkward, Luche merely burst into laughter, thrilled.
"You claim to be a contractor of the God of Construction?”
“Yes! Jin, I only found out recently. Suddenly I started hearing a voice in my head, saying 'I'm Barbovo, the God of Construction, would you like to make a contract with me?’...”
Barbovo was indeed a known name for the God of Construction.
It was a name that could only be known by someone who had studied about the gods to some extent.
“So, you wanted to use your powers as Barbovo's contractor and came looking for me?”

“Of course! I've always dreamt of joining the Barmel Union. I wanted to do something big with Jin someday. The fact that this dream could become a reality now! Heaven must have heard my wishes. I thought it would be difficult to meet Jin through magic or swordsmanship since I don't have a knack for those.”
"Calm your excitement a bit and let's have a conversation, Luche."
"Understood!"

"First of all, anyone can join the Barmel Union, even without special abilities. Broadly speaking, residents living in the Union's territories are also members. In that sense, you've been a member since you sought refuge here."
"That's even better. Now I can be more than just a simple union member, I might become one who works directly with you, Jin!"
Of course, even if Luche really was a prospective contractor of Barbovo, he knew nothing about the construction site of the Imperial Sword.
He sought Jin out with the thought that once he finished the contract and obtained his power, he could be of great help to the Barmel Union.
"I'd be happy if that were the case. But, what does it mean to be a prospective contractor? I heard you need trials to fully execute a contract with Barbovo."
"Ah, about that..."
For the first time, Luche seemed to shrink back at Jin's question.
Jin quietly observed him without reproaching.

"No, on second thought, before that, I should ask how you, being from the south of the Barkl Autonomous District, ended up here. If you're from Barkl, you must have belonged to a fairly wealthy side in the Lutero Federation."
As it's a city close to the Federation's capital, most of those living in Barkl, even commoners, belonged to the wealthy class.
The fact that Luche did not flinch even in front of Telrot was not only due to his fearless nature, but likely also because he grew up in a situation where he didn't have to cringe much.
More importantly,
Jin had a guess as to why Luche ended up here.
"My family went bankrupt."
"…Could it be, when the 4th generation of our family attacked the Barkl Autonomous District before the evil spirit died, that happened?"
-While requesting support from Tikan's side, there was one more attack.
- In the meantime, there couldn't have been another large-scale troop movement, could there?

- No. Defus Runecandel struck the Barkl Autonomous District with two black knights. Civilian damage wasn't too great since we were prepared... but the commander of the ghost legion was seriously injured. Cadun, not yet recovered, fought and fell into internal injuries.
The conversation that Jin had with Ronil at the time Defus attacked the Lutero Federation.
"Yes, we lost everything when Defus attacked."
Luche's family happened to be victims at that time.
Looking at Luche, who told his older brother that their family had gone bankrupt, Jin felt a lump in his chest.
As Jin's face darkened, Luche continually waved his hands as if it wasn't a big deal.

"But you shouldn't worry, Jin! It wasn't your order, and you even came to the Lutero Federation for support at the time! Besides, we lost our house and assets, but no one in my family died. We were all lucky to be outside at the time."
"That's at least fortunate. I'll try my best to restore the lost assets."

"That's not your job, is it? We should've received insurance money, but the damn Zipfl guys didn't give it to us. There were about fifteen affected households, including me, and none of us received anything. They said it was difficult to make payments during a war? I almost got killed going to confront Cadun, the fire dragon."
Telrot clicked his tongue once again at this point.
If Cadun had met him, Luche would not be of this world anymore.
"Anyway, at that time, my family's affection for Zipfl dropped sharply. With the strange rumors going around, my entire family decided to migrate to Hufester."
"Strange rumors?"

"Rumors that Zipfl is conducting biogolem experiments on the residents. Whether they're still shameless after their disgrace when you exposed them during your candidate days, there's no evidence yet, but they're still doing it!"
The possibility that Zipfl is conducting more biogolem experiments was something Jin had always considered.
The bio-golems of the devil sorcerers seen in the holy land could not have been made just like that.

"Anyway, losing the house and money hurts a bit. But my family is mostly positive like me, and we're determined to live well in Hufester. I just need to rise as a core member of the Union and provide for them…"
Jin patted Luche's shoulder with a smile.
"I should apologize anyway. For not being able to stop the 4th generation ahead of time."
"That's okay. Who doesn't owe you, Jin, in this world? If it weren't for you, we would have all died to the evil spirit. Let's leave it at that."
"First, I need to verify something about you. We need to officially confirm if you are indeed Barbovo's contractor."
"How can I do that? As a prospective contractor, I can't show my power…"
"You just stay still, it'll be over in a moment. Butler."
[Yes, Master.]
"Check Luche's records."
Ruret placed a hand on Luche's forehead and invoked his power.
[Luche, you said you heard Barbovo's voice not long ago, when exactly was that?]
"It was dawn a fortnight ago. Around four o'clock?"
[I'm going to examine your records from two weeks ago, don't be too surprised.]
As soon as Ruret's words ended, a video started to play over the record window.
It was a fortnight ago when Luche heard the voice of Barbovo.
Regrettably, Luche happened to be engrossed in a sensual novel that he found by chance while on the run.
Luche scratched the back of his head in embarrassment at that scene, and Jin chuckled, thinking of Murakan.

"Oh… how on earth did I pick up something like this. This might be a valuable sensual novel. According to the rumor, Murakan, your guardian dragon, likes to collect sensual novels. Should I take this with me later? Wait, who was that just now! Who spoke to me? What? Barbovo?"
Since Barbovo's voice only reached Luche's inner self, his voice did not appear in the video.
However, the possibility of manipulation or acting was extremely unlikely.
There was no reason to pretend to hear Barbovo's voice while reading a sensual novel alone in a corner of a shelter at four in the morning without his family knowing.

"Finally, an offer of a divine contract has come to me! Alright, what should I do? How...? How am I supposed to execute that right now? Wait a minute, Barbovo! God of Architecture! Give me some advice before you go!"
The video that Ruret confirmed ended there.
"Ha, haha! I never thought my private life would be exposed like this. It's a little embarrassing. By the way, would Murakan like this sensual novel?"
"Well, he usually reads any sensual novel first. It seems like the verification is done. So, can you tell me now what the trial Barbovo mentioned is necessary?"
Considering Luche's reaction earlier, and his questioning in the video about how he was supposed to do it.
The trial seemed to be something impossible for Luche to accomplish.
"Well, that trial is…"
"Don't be cautious, just speak freely."
"If I tell you, will you help me?"
"If it's something I can help with."
"Alright, I'll trust Jin and speak up. The trial that Barbovo asked for was this. Find a construction site that even Barbovo would be tempted by, and take charge."
A construction site tempting even to the God of Architecture...
Upon hearing that, Jin thought of the Huangji region.
Ruret and Telrot seemed to have the same thought.
'If this is true, there's no need to check the compass and risk disturbing the Bakl autonomous region.'
Jin grinned at Luche and responded.
"Luche, let's go somewhere together."
